question: In a woman with uterine rupture who has completed her family, hysterectomy is always preferred over uterine repair regardless of the extent of the tear.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Management of uterine rupture is individualised. A clean, uncontaminated, linear lower-segment tear in a woman who has not completed her family and is haemodynamically stable may be repaired with a good prognosis. Hysterectomy is reserved for extensive or uncontrollable tears.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. While hysterectomy is preferred in extensive, uncontrollable tears or in women who have completed their family, a clean, recent, linear lower-segment tear in a haemodynamically stable patient may be repaired — especially if family is not complete. The decision is individualised.
